pr_title: Fix locking/unlocking transition state in Matter lock platform
pr_body:
## Proposed change

There was an incorrect assumption in the implementation of the Matter lock platform that the state 'NotFullyLocked' was to indicate the lock is transitioning to the next state but that is not true.

The specification says:

`The Not Fully Locked value is used by a lock to indicate that the state of the lock is somewhere between Locked and Unlocked so it is only partially secured. For example, a deadbolt could be par­tially extended and not in a dead latched state.`

In fact a lock may use this state (value 0) to indicate the lock is unlocked, as reported for at least SwitchBot in #120694 so the whole code was wrong. Fixed the code to treat NotFullyLocked as unlocked and use optimistic state for locking/unlocking instead (reset as soon as a state change comes in).

The lock is reporting its state as 0, meaning "Not Fully Locked" which is a bit of a grey area.
This is what the spec says about it:

`The Not Fully Locked value is used by a lock to indicate that the state of the lock is somewhere between Locked and Unlocked so it is only partially secured. For example, a deadbolt could be par­tially extended and not in a dead latched state.`

Now my question is, if you actually control the lock by opening it, doe the state correct then ?
Currently we treat this state as a transition phase (which we should fix) but it makes me wonder if the state even gets updated.

Hi,

When I control the lock the state remains unknown. Doesn't matter if I fully close it or open.

The lock has 3 main states I will say, . 

- One when the door is closed without a dead bolt. This is how the door stays almost always. 
![Screenshot_20240703_181028_Gallery.jpg](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/5490201/f8061d1d-fcc6-4721-82d3-fe9fa443a46f)

- Other when the door was closed including the dead bolt

![Screenshot_20240703_185612_SwitchBot.jpg](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/5490201/829c1d15-4496-4063-8d13-b9f6167e5847)

- And the last one when the door is open
![Screenshot_20240703_185728_SwitchBot.jpg](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/5490201/5b18f576-4399-4953-8969-0b0ee2e34c0b)



Eventually it could also be open but with the dead bolt closed I suppose

OK, in that case this is a SwitchBot bug as well.
I can fix the mapping on our side but that will still not fix it for you. I think the LockState will just always be zero (so they don't update it).

Would it be possible for you to also add this lock to e.g. apple home or google home through mater to see if the issue exists there as well ?
I will see how to do it. I do not use any of those services.

OK, at least I fixed the translation for the Lockstate on our side but I guess this will not completely fix your issue.
Let's await the next patch release of HA 2024.7.1 to see if that solves the issue for you

Thanks, I can make no promises but I would try to setup a dev environment so I can help/debug the lock. As a typescript developer, I have no idea how hard that is 😬 .

As extra info, The kind of lock I have in my door I have is this one. I think that is important and I completelly forgot to post it before.
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/5490201/b69b2ec4-3a9e-4097-bb97-a5e23fbd91ff)

OK, please test with HA update 2024.7.1 - that at least fixes the bug on our end.
If that doesn't solve the issue, you would need to create a bug report with SwitchBot that their Matter bridge implementation has a bug: the LockState is not reflecting the actual lock state.
